QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Blaze Wizard
QuestInfo.0: The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Blaze Wizard, the Magician of fire, talk to the #bChief Knight of Fire #p1101004##k.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to become a hot-blooded #bBlaze Wizard#k of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101004#.
QuestInfo.2: You are now a Blaze Wizard!

0.0: Oooh! A new knight! Nice to meet ya! I'm #p1101004#, #bChief Knight of Fire#k and #bleader of the Blaze Wizards#k.
0.1: Sooooo, Blaze Wizards are like Magicians in that we have #bhigh INT and Magic ATT#k and loathe melee combat, but we're also so much more!
0.2: We've bonded with #bIgnis, the spirit of fire#k! You can summon him to fight with you in battles, which makes you super duper extra powerful! That's something regular old Magicians can only dream of.
0.3: We're looking for people who have a passion to succeed... people who never ever give up, no matter how scary their enemies are. If you think you have the spark and sizzle to be a #bBlaze Wizard#k, let me know!

yes.0: Pursue that path that fits YOU!
